0.literal: We're heading to Sotenbori. Is there anything you've left undone?
0.official: Get down to Sotenbori. No unfinished business left here?

1.literal: ...is there? Anywhere's fine, as long as I don't freeze to death.
1.official: Any chance you know of a place I could sleep for the night? As long as I don't freeze, I'm not picky.

2.literal: I'm not into that sort of thing.

3.literal: I'll show you to the holding cells now, but...
3.official: I'm good to take you to the holdin' cells whenever.

4.official: (Looks like that door's my only way through...)

5.literal: (Looks like Oda and Tachibana escaped safely.)
5.official: (Looks like Oda and Tachibana made it out okay.)

6.literal: Just as I thought, they don't look like they'll let us walk out the front door easily...
6.official: Well, forget walking out the front door...

7.literal: We should have jumped into this knowing the risks from the start.
7.official: Are you so surprised? I thought we both came here knowing the risks.

8.official: We have weathered worse storms together numerous times.

9.literal: All right then, shall we do this properly?
9.official: All right, then let's do this thing!

10.literal: If I keep relying on the new guy, it'll hurt my dignity as his senior.
10.official: Can't let the rookie think he's the only one pulling his weight here.

11.literal: The exit's over there. Let's hurry.

12.literal: It's blocked from the other side.

13.literal: Should I try jumping over to that window?

15.literal: If you want to kill me, scrape together 100 million yen and come back.
15.official: If you want me dead, put together another 100 million yen and try again.

16.literal: Ah! You're the one from the time with that demon-sword customer the other day...
16.official: Hey! It's the guy who was fixing to sell that sword.

17.literal: Because of you, I took a huge loss...
17.official: I lost a lot of money thanks to you.

18.literal: How are you going to make amends for this?
18.official: How are you going to make this right?

19.literal: Now that it's come to this, I'll face you head-on and make a bloody example of you.
19.official: Fine, I'll just have to take care of you myself.

20.literal: I was just getting in the mood to knock someone down.
20.official: Punching someone would be great right now.

21.literal: Exploit an opening in the enemy and force in a combo attack.
21.official: Exploit a gap in the enemy's defenses to unleash a combo attack.

22.literal: Press the button on an enemy that is startled and flinching.

23.literal: ...Kamoji, not just on the surface, you...

24.literal: ...were a fine master who gave me real advice.

25.literal: It can cut even a guy who looks this quick, see!?
25.official: The guy was pretty quick, but you still sliced him up good!

26.literal: My heart was pounding, thinking he'd be cut in two, but...
26.official: I was hoping the sword could slice him in two.

28.literal: That's what you get for trying to run a cheap scam.
28.official: You're blaming me for your shady business deal going bust? Get a life.

29.literal: Far from a demon sword, that was a blade that didn't even cut well.
29.official: No. In fact, it had mostly lost its edge.

30.literal: Still... someone who can casually plunk down ten million yen
30.official: Who can afford to slap down ten million like that, anyway?

31.literal: must have a pretty strange sense of things after all.
31.official: Must have his priorities all wrong.

32.literal: Using your hands to handle the opponent is a good method too.
32.official: Shoving the enemy is another option.

34.literal: An evasive technique that swaps your position with the enemy's.
34.official: This lets you evade and switch places with the enemy.

35.literal: While in your stance, press the button in time with the enemy's attack.
35.official: Hold to enter a fighting stance, then in time with an enemy's attack.

36.literal: That's 15 million yen back to you in total.
36.official: That makes it 15 million yen for you.

37.literal: I gave you some really good advice this time, didn't I?
37.official: I think I gave you some pretty good advice.

38.literal: Even after I pay in my cut, there'll be plenty left over.
38.official: That'll cover what I need to deliver to the family, and leave plenty of change.

39.literal: Guess I'll blow the rest in one go!

40.official: You gots to put in a little more effort, Kiryu-san.

41.literal: ...Kiryu-san, don't let this put you off, keep at it!
41.official: Don't get discouraged, Kiryu-san! You can do this!

42.literal: Ngh... I can't land a hit!
42.official: Damn, you're hard to pin down!

43.literal: Wow, that opponent had a powerful punch!
43.official: That guy sure packed a punch, didn't he?

44.literal: If I could step back even further from there...

46.literal: Heh, even split in half, that's a decent amount...
46.official: Heh, even half the winnings is a nice prize.

47.literal: Heh heh... The prize money's mine.
47.official: Heh heh. I'll be taking that prize money.

48.literal: You can use Sway while keeping the enemy in front of you.
48.official: Hold to enter a fighting stance, then to Quickstep while still facing the enemy.

49.literal: Wow, that was some splendid dodging, eh?
49.official: Good work, Kiryu-san! You was quick as the wind there!

50.literal: Yeah... It was more of a thrill than just some drunk.
50.official: Well, it was a better challenge than a drunk at least.

51.literal: When you take a hit, don't panic, just swing your head.
51.official: When you take a hit, swing your head around so's you don't eat another big punch.

52.literal: Swing my head... You mean weaving, huh.
52.official: Swing my head? Like bobbing and weaving?

53.literal: We split the 100,000 yen challenge fee, and what I was holding for you, Kiryu-san...
53.official: About the winnings, we split the ¥100,000 entry fee, and I'll give you back your stake.

55.literal: But moving around a bit cleared my head. Thanks.
55.official: Still, the exercise did me good. Thanks.

56.literal: Too bad! We'll be waiting for your next challenge!
56.official: Nice effort there! Always happy to do a rematch!

57.literal: Good thing the customer seems really satisfied too.

58.official: Yeah, it turned out all right.

59.literal: Next time I think you should try dodging at the very last moment.
59.official: One thing you can try is evading at the last possible moment.

61.official: Press in time with enemy attacks to build up the Heat Gauge.

62.literal: You won all the rounds. Congratulations.

65.literal: The prize money is double the challenge fee.

66.literal: We only have to cover the other half.
66.official: Half of that's the up-front fee, so we only needs to fork over the other half.

67.literal: Their movements are in a straight line so they're easy to dodge, and their punches are weak.
67.official: Come at you in a nice, straight line, easy to dodge. Punches are garbage, too.

68.literal: So rather than tough guys proud of their strength who are after the prize money,
68.official: So most challengers are guys looking to blow off steam by hitting someone, and not tough guys looking to win some cash, huh?

69.literal: Seems word of that has spread a little too far.
69.official: Word's getting around, so I get more gawkers and less challengers.

70.literal: What would happen if my apprentice showed up there?
70.official: But with an apprentice, I reckon that'd change.
